summary: Commerce security patch-point analysis for SEC-COUPON-002 (CRITICAL), PAY-006, PAY-002, PAY-005. All hook points evidenced with file:line. No edits performed.

findings.detail: Defect: applyOrderCoupon ignores coupon target_scope entirely. The method sums discounted_subtotal across ALL items and applies discount to that grand total (line 1389-1392), then apportions that discount to every item regardless of includedProducts/excludedProducts/includedCategories/excludedCategories. The same Coupon model that the product-coupon path filters through filterItemsByScope (line 1940-1981, supporting PRODUCTS/CATEGORIES/ALL scopes + included/excluded lists) is loaded by the order-coupon path (line 257 — filterCouponsByType only filters by target_type ORDER_AMOUNT, not scope). Only min_order_amount is checked against the full $totalOrderAmount (line 1399-1411) — there is NO call to filterItemsByScope or any scope-equivalent logic. Quantification: a coupon with target_type=ORDER_AMOUNT + target_scope=PRODUCTS (single specific product) gets applied to the full cart total, then apportioned to every option including out-of-scope items (each item's order_discount_share is increased at line 1421), and calculatePaymentAmount then subtracts it from the full payment_amount (line 1489). The defect is structurally identical to the product-coupon path's correct logic — but the scope filter is missing.
findings.evidence: modules/_bundled/sirsoft-ecommerce/src/Services/OrderCalculationService.php:1376-1452 (applyOrderCoupon); compare 769-847 (applyProductCoupons correctly calls filterItemsByScope at line 770); scope enum at 1940-1981 (filterItemsByScope). Single-coupon break at line 1448.

findings.detail:
Ranked interception points (all confirmed to exist in code, plugin can register a listener class via AbstractPlugin::getHookListeners() → HookListenerRegistrar::applySubscribedHooks → HookManager::addFilter, app/Extension/HookListenerRegistrar.php:112-116):

1) PRIMARY (clean fix, surgical): sirsoft-ecommerce.calculation.before_order_discount — fires at line 259 with ($orderCoupons, $itemsAfterProductDiscount, $preparedItems). Plugin can mutate $orderCoupons[] to drop coupons whose scope doesn't match items present, or alter itemsAfterProductDiscount so the total reflects only scoped items, then leave the rest of the pipeline untouched. Same pattern as shipping at line 238-242 (plugins already use this for shipping).

2) SECONDARY (post-hoc clamp): sirsoft-ecommerce.calculation.after_order_discount — fires at line 272 with ($itemsAfterOrderDiscount, $orderCoupons, $preparedItems). Plugin recomputes the correct scoped sum, overwrites order_discount_share per option, and recomputes the final total downstream by also adjusting payment_calculation via the next filter.

3) FALLBACK (last-resort full override): sirsoft-ecommerce.calculation.after_final_result — fires at line 371 with the full OrderCalculationResult. Plugin can rewrite summary.payment_amount and summary.orderCouponDiscount and items[].orderCouponDiscountShare. Heaviest but does not depend on pipeline internals.

NO direct "scope-aware reapply" hook exists; no event listener for OrderCalculation*; CheckoutDataService does not dispatch a scope check; no OrderCalculationService::calculate() wrapper decorator is exposed via service container — EcommerceServiceProvider.php:147-188 binds repositories only, OrderCalculationService is consumed raw (no interface). A decorator would require modifying the module binding or registering a bound singleton override.

Coupon repo: CouponIssueRepositoryInterface (line 152 binding) — cannot be safely replaced because OrderCalculationService injects the interface (line 91) but a plugin rebinding would change behavior for the whole request (no per-call scope). Last resort only.
findings.evidence: Filter hook list: OrderCalculationService.php:163,170,179,194,204,213,229,238,249,260,272,283,296,309,324,336,371. Hook registration mechanism: app/Extension/HookListenerRegistrar.php:101-131, plugin entry: app/Extension/AbstractPlugin.php:461. Plugin discovery pattern: plugins/sirsoft-daum_postcode/plugin.php (AbstractPlugin::getHookListeners).

findings.detail: Payment_method is whitelisted by CreateOrderRequest (line 67-81): Rule::in(PaymentMethodResolver::allValidIds()) plus closure on isOrderable($value). PaymentMethodResolver::allValidIds (PaymentMethodResolver.php:163-169) merges PaymentMethodEnum::values() + array_keys(catalog()) where catalog is order_settings.payment_methods (line 219). The catalog is extended at runtime by the filter hook sirsoft-ecommerce.settings.filter_available_payment_methods (EcommerceSettingsService.php:849-852). PG providers are registered by hook sirsoft-ecommerce.payment.registered_pg_providers (EcommerceSettingsService.php:862-868) and consumed by HandlesOrderCreation::resolvePgPaymentHandler (HandlesOrderCreation.php:271-284) and PaymentMethodResolver via _orphaned_pg (PaymentMethodResolver.php:185-194). The client-config hook sirsoft-ecommerce.payment.get_client_config is consumed in Shop/PaymentConfigController.php:27. Where is_active / available lives: EcommerceSettingsService::getPublicPaymentSettings line 248-285 (which strips _orphaned and _orphaned_pg), and PaymentMethodResolver::isOrderable line 185-194.

Ranked interception points for payment_method rejection:

1) PRIMARY: sirsoft-ecommerce.order.create_validation_rules filter hook — fires at CreateOrderRequest.php:133 with ($rules, $request). Plugin can append a custom Rule::in() over a PG-plugin-managed blacklist, or override the closure that runs isOrderable. This is the only filter hook the order-create FormRequest exposes — analogous to checkout.update_validation_rules (UpdateCheckoutRequest.php:55) and checkout.validation_rules (CheckoutRequest.php:56). This is the canonical "extend the validation set" precedent the brief referenced.

2) SECONDARY: sirsoft-ecommerce.checkout.before_payment action — fires in HandlesOrderCreation.php:84 with ($tempOrder, $userId), executed AFTER validation and AFTER tempOrder resolve but BEFORE OrderProcessingService::createFromTempOrder (line 87). Plugin can throw a custom exception (return-path: error caught at line 214-219 → 500) OR mutate $tempOrder before order creation. Less surgical than #1 because #1 fires before any tempOrder lookup.

3) TERTIARY (route-level): Add middleware via plugin — plugin.php getHookListeners-style middleware. The route POST /api/modules/sirsoft-ecommerce/user/orders is defined at modules/_bundled/sirsoft-ecommerce/src/routes/api.php:258-260 with middleware ['optional.sanctum', 'permission:user,sirsoft-ecommerce.user-orders.create']. AbstractPlugin declares middleware-via-ExtensionMiddlewareGate (AbstractPlugin.php:515+), but the G7 extension middleware gate targets web/api by route name/URI pattern, not module-route. Plugins do not normally register middleware against sirsoft-ecommerce.user.orders.store — no precedent found. Marked BLOCKER as a viable in-place rejection without core modification.

4) MODEL OBSERVER: No Order observer dispatching payment_method validation was found (grep across modules/_bundled/sirsoft-ecommerce/src found no Observers directory). No Laravel model observer hooks for Order::creating that gate payment_method — NOT APPLICABLE for this defect.

5) OrderProcessingService events: doAction sirsoft-ecommerce.order.before_create fires at OrderProcessingService.php:112 AFTER validation+tempOrder but is the latest plugin-reachable point. Cannot reject — fires AFTER order record creation begins.
findings.evidence: Filter hook: CreateOrderRequest.php:133. Precedent hooks: UpdateCheckoutRequest.php:55, CheckoutRequest.php:56, ExtendCheckoutRequest.php:19, DeleteCheckoutRequest.php:19, ShowCheckoutRequest.php:35, Admin/OrderListRequest.php:108, User/UpdateOrderShippingAddressRequest.php:71. Order route: modules/_bundled/sirsoft-ecommerce/src/routes/api.php:258-260. Action hook: HandlesOrderCreation.php:84. Order event: OrderProcessingService.php:112. Listener registration: HookListenerRegistrar.php:101-131.
findings.topic: PAY-006/002/005 — Plugin payment_method rejection points ranked

findings.detail:
Plugin hook contract: plugins extend App\Extension\AbstractPlugin (app/Extension/AbstractPlugin.php). Hook registration entry points:
- getHooks() (line 448) — declares hooks the plugin EMITS (documentation/metadata).
- getHookListeners() (line 461) — declares hooks the plugin SUBSCRIBES to, returned as array<hookName, ['method'=>..., 'priority'=>..., 'type'=>'action|filter', 'sync'=>bool]>.
Registration flow: AbstractModule/PluginManager scans getHookListeners() → HookListenerRegistrar::applySubscribedHooks (app/Extension/HookListenerRegistrar.php:101-131) → HookManager::addFilter/addAction. Filter type: synchronously chainable (line 113-116); action type: queued by default unless 'sync' true (line 117-124). Plugin-side code follows the listener-class pattern (no module-service-provider-style registrations found in sirsoft-daum_postcode or sirsoft-ckeditor5 — both rely on AbstractPlugin::getHookListeners()).
findings.evidence: app/Extension/AbstractPlugin.php:448-464; app/Extension/HookListenerRegistrar.php:101-131; example plugins: plugins/sirsoft-daum_postcode/plugin.php (extends AbstractPlugin, declares emitted hooks in getHooks()), plugins/sirsoft-ckeditor5/plugin.php:15.

recommendations: SEC-COUPON-002 (CRITICAL): ship the fix in the companion plugin plugins/_bundled/superbify-commerce-compat/ using filter hook sirsoft-ecommerce.calculation.before_order_discount (OrderCalculationService.php:259) as the primary interception — mutate $orderCoupons or pre-strip out-of-scope items from $itemsAfterProductDiscount, whichever the team prefers. Mirror the filterItemsByScope logic from OrderCalculationService.php:1940-1981. Keep a fallback at sirsoft-ecommerce.calculation.after_final_result (line 371) that recomputes summary.orderCouponDiscount and summary.payment_amount if the upstream filters are bypassed (defense in depth). Register via AbstractPlugin::getHookListeners() returning the hook map pointing to a listener class under plugins/_bundled/superbify-commerce-compat/.

PAY-006/002/005: ship the payment_method blacklist/whitelist gate in the same companion plugin via filter hook sirsoft-ecommerce.order.create_validation_rules (CreateOrderRequest.php:133) — append a closure Rule that rejects payment methods not registered through sirsoft-ecommerce.payment.registered_pg_providers (EcommerceSettingsService.php:862-868) and not in the PG-plugin's own allowlist. Do NOT rely on route middleware (#3 in PAY ranking) — no sirsoft-ecommerce plugin precedent and BLOCKER-listed.

Do NOT attempt service-container decorator overrides for OrderCalculationService — EcommerceServiceProvider.php:147-188 binds repositories but not OrderCalculationService; rebinding would affect the entire request.
For QA evidence pairing: filter hooks above are all present in `_workspace/ecommerce-qa/` baseline (results.json) — no QA re-run needed; re-use evidence/screenshots only when reproducing the defect.
blockersFound: Route-level middleware injection against modules/_bundled/sirsoft-ecommerce/src/routes/api.php:258-260 has no precedent for sirsoft-* plugins targeting module-owned routes; AbstractPlugin middleware self-gate targets route-name/URI patterns outside the module's namespace. Marked BLOCKER for payment_method rejection via middleware path.
No Order model observer exists (no Observers directory in modules/_bundled/sirsoft-ecommerce/src). PAY-related observer-based rejection not available.

OrderProcessingService::createFromTempOrder begins order-record creation BEFORE the sirsoft-ecommerce.order.before_create action fires (OrderProcessingService.php:112 vs. HandlesOrderCreation.php:87-99). Plugin cannot reject from before_create without leaving half-created order rows; do not rely on it as the rejection point.
